game.title: Yakuza 3 Remastered
game.blurb: Remastered open-world action-adventure in which Kazuma Kiryu runs an orphanage in Okinawa and is drawn back to Kamurocho, from Ryu ga Gotoku Studio, released 2021-01-27. RAWG average playtime: 6 hours. Genres: Action, Adventure. Chapters are an estimate drawn from Steam achievement themes.

chapters.title: The Main Story
chapters.summary: Kiryu's story from Okinawa to Kamurocho, chapter by chapter. Spoiler-guarded; these achievements are hidden.

chapters.title: Substories, Hitmen and Good Deeds
chapters.summary: Substory milestones, catching every hitman and cleaning the beach at Morning Glory.

chapters.title: Fighting, Revelations and Masters
chapters.summary: Heat Actions, Revelations, the masters, modded weapons and the Coliseum.

chapters.title: Minigames and Nightlife
chapters.summary: Hostess clubs, restaurants, massage, darts, pool, karaoke, bowling, gambling, shogi, mahjong, golf, fishing and more.

chapters.title: City Life and Money
chapters.summary: Lockers in Kamurocho and Downtown Ryukyu, saving yen and running a marathon distance.

chapters.title: Legend Difficulty and Ultimate Match
chapters.summary: Beating the game on Legend and the Ultimate Match rounds after the ending.

attribution: Achievement data from Steam (Steam Web API, app 1088710)
StrategyWiki: no usable walkthrough, nothing used — https://strategywiki.org/wiki/Yakuza_3
Fandom (yakuza.fandom.com, CC BY-SA): page names only were checked to confirm structure; no text copied — https://yakuza.fandom.com/wiki/Yakuza_3
notes: Backlog game, picked from RAWG's most-added list for its year (docs/PLAN.md section 2 ordering). StrategyWiki redirects "Yakuza 3 Remastered" to "Yakuza 3" (completion stage 0, a perfect stub); its Walkthrough, Substories, Minigames, Gameplay and "Achievements and trophies" subpages are linked but not written, and the only written subpages are "Controls" and "Table of Contents", so nothing was used. yakuza.fandom.com answers the API under "Yakuza 3", with about 74 linked pages, including subpages "Chapter 1" to "Chapter 12", "Substories", "Heat Actions" and "Coliseum Stats" (its "Yakuza 3 Remastered" page has only 4 links); names only were looked at, nothing copied. The Steam schema calls the app "RINO" (an internal codename); the store list confirms app 1088710. 15 of 50 Steam achievements are hidden; they sit in the main story chapter, though "Careless Dragon", "People Watcher" and "Compulsive Vandal" may be side goals. RAWG lists a playtime of only 6 hours, which looks low.
